rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, successfully matching to a single user. It retrieved the user's orders via read-only tools, identified which were pending, and correctly summarized them. Before making any changes, the agent clearly stated the intended cancellations and requested explicit confirmation along with a reason. After the user confirmed, the agent executed cancellations using the appropriate tool for both pending orders only, and then confirmed the results. All actions were on the authenticated user's own orders. The information provided (order totals, items, payment method last four) matched tool data. A minor note is the stated refund timeframe (5–7 business days) is not explicitly shown by tools, but it's a standard policy statement and does not conflict with tool outputs. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
